tests/fuzz/src/world.rs:2196
FUZZ-ORACLE R3B-2 JIT capture: [deposit 121628551839, expire, withdraw 60814275919500 of 60814275919500 minted shares] gained 2568240 lamports over the exit without the deposit (bound 2: the minted shares' part of the immediate rent credit 0 = lender rent 1610671 − credited Some(1610671), S 65009768696000) and took back 121628551839 tokens for the 121628551839 its shares were worth at the deposit
resolution: Resolved in the fuzzer, no program change: the oracle's lender SOL counts the `LenderPosition`'s lamports too (wallet + account + touched balance), so a close's rent refund is neutral. The bound is unchanged (the minted shares' part of `max(0, lender_rent − credited_for(pos))`, none of the lump). This file replays as a regression: the run must pass (`corpus_replays`).
